name: Brave Metal
main_effect: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 6 or less. If you have a Digimon with 5 or more digivolution cards and [X Antibody] trait in play, you may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon without [X Antibody] trait instead.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
